description: Find health indicators in the WHO Regional Office for Europe Data Warehouse by name — tuberculosis incidence, life expectancy, hospital beds, alcohol consumption, immunization coverage and thousands more across 53 European countries, many with series back to the 1970s. Returns the measure code needed to fetch data, with the indicator name and when its data was last updated. Use to find European health statistics and WHO Europe indicator codes.

dataset.description: Restrict to one dataset code, e.g. "HFA" or "HFAMDB". Optional.

query.description: Words from the indicator name, e.g. "tuberculosis incidence" or "life expectancy".

name: who_euro_search_measures
title: Who Euro Search Measures
